descriptionChirho: Intense anger or fierce displeasure, typically of God directed against sin or enemies; the core and dominant sense of za'am covering righteous indignation and wrathful fury.

A sense of bitter indignation or resentful vexation, distinguished by multilingual evidence showing Swahili 'uchungu' (bitterness), Arabic 'ightiyāẓ' (vexation), and Korean 'bungae' (resentful indignation) rather than the standard wrath vocabulary.
